title: Missing fetus syndrome: grays take back hybrid fetuses
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Missing fetus syndrome: grays take back hybrid fetuses, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The grays come and get the fetus.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes what he calls missing fetus syndrome. He says that when some abducted women are pregnant with part-human, part-alien babies, the pregnancy vanishes because the grays, small grey-skinned aliens, come and take the fetus. If true, aliens would be breeding hybrids using human mothers.
